ai_look_check.name: ai_look_check
ai_look_check.value: kind IN ('producto','carga_producto','carga','texto') and state IN ('mirando','lista','fallo') and "ai_look"."photos" between 1 and 100 and ("ai_look"."state" = 'mirando') = ("ai_look"."finished_at" is null) and ("ai_look"."failure" is null or char_length("ai_look"."failure") <= 300) and ("ai_look"."notice" is null or char_length("ai_look"."notice") <= 300) and ("ai_look"."kind" <> 'producto' or "ai_look"."product_id" is not null) and ("ai_look"."kind" not in ('carga', 'carga_producto') or "ai_look"."load_id" is not null) and ("ai_look"."kind" <> 'carga_producto' or "ai_look"."item_id" is not null)

ai_proposal_check.name: ai_proposal_check
ai_proposal_check.value: state IN ('propuesta','usada','cambiada','descartada') and "ai_proposal"."field" ~ '^(nombre|categoria|rubro|descripcion|palabras|color|juntar|(dato|pregunta):[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,39})$' and char_length("ai_proposal"."reason") between 1 and 300 and ("ai_proposal"."value" is null or octet_length("ai_proposal"."value"::text) <= 8000) and ("ai_proposal"."applied_value" is null or octet_length("ai_proposal"."applied_value"::text) <= 8000) and ("ai_proposal"."state" = 'propuesta') = ("ai_proposal"."decided_at" is null) and ("ai_proposal"."decided_at" is null) = ("ai_proposal"."decided_by" is null) and ("ai_proposal"."product_id" is not null or "ai_proposal"."item_id" is not null or "ai_proposal"."load_id" is not null)

bulk_load_state_check.name: bulk_load_state_check
bulk_load_state_check.value: state IN ('abierta','creada','descartada') and ("bulk_load"."state" = 'abierta') = ("bulk_load"."finished_at" is null) and ("bulk_load"."state" = 'creada') = ("bulk_load"."created_products" is not null)

bulk_load_item_check.name: bulk_load_item_check
bulk_load_item_check.value: state IN ('revisar','listo','quitado') and char_length("bulk_load_item"."name") <= 120 and ("bulk_load_item"."category" is null or char_length("bulk_load_item"."category") <= 60) and char_length("bulk_load_item"."description") <= 2000 and ("bulk_load_item"."doubt" is null or char_length("bulk_load_item"."doubt") <= 200) and ("bulk_load_item"."list_price_cents" is null or "bulk_load_item"."list_price_cents" between 1 and 100000000) and jsonb_typeof("bulk_load_item"."options") = 'array' and jsonb_typeof("bulk_load_item"."variants") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("bulk_load_item"."variants") <= 200

bulk_load_photo_check.name: bulk_load_photo_check
bulk_load_photo_check.value: content_type IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp') and char_length("bulk_load_photo"."file_name") <= 200 and "bulk_load_photo"."object_key" ~ '^[a-z0-9/-]{1,200}$' and "bulk_load_photo"."size_bytes" between 1 and 8000000

cash_handover_note_check.name: cash_handover_note_check
cash_handover_note_check.value: ("cash_handover"."note" is null or char_length(btrim("cash_handover"."note")) between 3 and 300) and ("cash_handover"."received_cents" = "cash_handover"."expected_cents" or "cash_handover"."note" is not null)

contract_outbox_pending_idx.name: contract_outbox_pending_idx
contract_outbox_pending_idx.where: sent_at is null and rejected_at is null

contract_outbox_rejected_check.name: contract_outbox_rejected_check
contract_outbox_rejected_check.value: "contract_outbox"."rejected_at" is null or ("contract_outbox"."sent_at" is null and "contract_outbox"."type" = 'pago.comprobante')

conversation_texts_check.name: conversation_texts_check
conversation_texts_check.value: ("conversation"."customer_name" is null or char_length(btrim("conversation"."customer_name")) between 1 and 120) and ("conversation"."waiting_reason" is null or char_length(btrim("conversation"."waiting_reason")) between 3 and 200)

conversation_message_delivery_check.name: conversation_message_delivery_check
conversation_message_delivery_check.value: ("conversation_message"."delivery" is null or delivery IN ('prueba','sin_enviar')) and (("conversation_message"."author" = 'cliente') = ("conversation_message"."delivery" is null))

conversation_message_follow_check.name: conversation_message_follow_check
conversation_message_follow_check.value: ("conversation_message"."follow_up" is null) = ("conversation_message"."follow_up_ref" is null) and ("conversation_message"."follow_up" is null or (follow_up IN ('pago','gracias','volvio','volver') and "conversation_message"."author" = 'sofi'))

customer_texts_check.name: customer_texts_check
customer_texts_check.value: char_length(btrim("customer"."name")) between 1 and 120 and ("customer"."phone" is null or char_length("customer"."phone") between 1 and 30) and char_length("customer"."note") <= 1000

order_payment_texts_check.name: order_payment_texts_check
order_payment_texts_check.value: ("order_payment"."operation" is null or char_length("order_payment"."operation") between 1 and 60) and ("order_payment"."note" is null or char_length("order_payment"."note") <= 300)

order_payment_photo_check.name: order_payment_photo_check
order_payment_photo_check.value: ("order_payment"."photo" is null) = ("order_payment"."photo_type" is null) and ("order_payment"."photo_type" is null or photo_type IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')) and ("order_payment"."photo" is null or octet_length("order_payment"."photo") between 1 and 1500000)

product_wholesale_check.name: product_wholesale_check
product_wholesale_check.value: ("product"."wholesale_min_quantity" is null) = ("product"."wholesale_price_cents" is null) and ("product"."wholesale_min_quantity" is null or ("product"."wholesale_min_quantity" between 2 and 10000 and "product"."wholesale_price_cents" > 0 and "product"."wholesale_price_cents" < "product"."list_price_cents"))

product_offers_check.name: product_offers_check
product_offers_check.value: ("product"."combo_percent_off" is null or "product"."combo_percent_off" between 1 and 90) and ("product"."offer_gift" is null or char_length(btrim("product"."offer_gift")) between 1 and 80)

product_status_check.name: product_status_check
product_status_check.value: ("product"."status" is null or status IN ('encargo','cupo','preventa','liquidacion','no_se_vende')) and coalesce("product"."status" = 'encargo', false) = ("product"."status_days" is not null) and coalesce("product"."status" = 'cupo', false) = ("product"."status_per_day" is not null) and coalesce("product"."status" = 'preventa', false) = ("product"."status_date" is not null) and ("product"."status_days" is null or "product"."status_days" between 1 and 365) and ("product"."status_per_day" is null or "product"."status_per_day" between 1 and 1000)

product_package_check.name: product_package_check
product_package_check.value: ("product"."package_weight_g" is null or "product"."package_weight_g" between 1 and 1000000) and (("product"."package_length_mm" is null and "product"."package_width_mm" is null and "product"."package_height_mm" is null) or ("product"."package_length_mm" is not null and "product"."package_width_mm" is not null and "product"."package_height_mm" is not null and "product"."package_length_mm" between 1 and 10000 and "product"."package_width_mm" between 1 and 10000 and "product"."package_height_mm" between 1 and 10000))

product_category_check.name: product_category_check
product_category_check.value: "product"."category" is null or char_length(btrim("product"."category")) between 1 and 60

product_color_hex_check.name: product_color_hex_check
product_color_hex_check.value: ("product_color"."hex" is null or "product_color"."hex" ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$') and ("product_color"."hex2" is null or ("product_color"."hex" is not null and "product_color"."hex2" ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$'))

product_event_changes_check.name: product_event_changes_check
product_event_changes_check.value: jsonb_typeof("product_event"."changes") = 'array' and ("product_event"."reason" is null or char_length("product_event"."reason") <= 300)

product_photo_size_check.name: product_photo_size_check
product_photo_size_check.value: "product_photo"."content" is null or octet_length("product_photo"."content") between 1 and 1500000

product_photo_where_check.name: product_photo_where_check
product_photo_where_check.value: ("product_photo"."content" is not null or "product_photo"."object_key" is not null) and ("product_photo"."object_key" is null or "product_photo"."object_key" ~ '^[a-z0-9/-]{1,200}$') and ("product_photo"."size_bytes" is null or "product_photo"."size_bytes" between 1 and 8000000) and ("product_photo"."cutout" is null or ("product_photo"."object_key" is not null and cutout IN ('propuesta','usada'))) and ("product_photo"."cutout" is null) = ("product_photo"."cutout_id" is null)

product_promotion_scope_check.name: product_promotion_scope_check
product_promotion_scope_check.value: ("product_promotion"."option_index" is null) = ("product_promotion"."option_value" is null) and ("product_promotion"."option_index" is null or ("product_promotion"."option_index" between 0 and 2 and char_length(btrim("product_promotion"."option_value")) between 1 and 30))

product_question_texts_check.name: product_question_texts_check
product_question_texts_check.value: char_length(btrim("product_question"."question")) between 3 and 500 and ("product_question"."answer" is null or char_length(btrim("product_question"."answer")) between 1 and 1000)

product_question_answer_check.name: product_question_answer_check
product_question_answer_check.value: ("product_question"."answer" is null) = ("product_question"."answered_by" is null) and ("product_question"."answer" is null) = ("product_question"."answered_at" is null) and ("product_question"."saved_at" is null) = ("product_question"."saved_by" is null) and ("product_question"."saved_at" is null or "product_question"."answer" is not null) and (not "product_question"."save_requested" or ("product_question"."answer" is not null and "product_question"."saved_at" is null))

product_variant_barcode_uidx.name: product_variant_barcode_uidx
product_variant_barcode_uidx.where: removed_at is null and barcode is not null

product_video_check.name: product_video_check
product_video_check.value: char_length("product_video"."label") <= 60 and "product_video"."object_key" ~ '^[a-z0-9/-]{1,200}$' and "product_video"."size_bytes" between 1 and 16000000 and "product_video"."duration_ms" between 1 and 30000 and "product_video"."width" between 1 and 4096 and "product_video"."height" between 1 and 4096

push_device_keys_check.name: push_device_keys_check
push_device_keys_check.value: char_length("push_device"."endpoint") between 10 and 1000 and char_length("push_device"."p256dh") between 1 and 200 and char_length("push_device"."auth") between 1 and 100

sale_order_customer_check.name: sale_order_customer_check
sale_order_customer_check.value: char_length(btrim("sale_order"."customer_name")) between 1 and 120 and ("sale_order"."customer_phone" is null or char_length("sale_order"."customer_phone") <= 30) and char_length("sale_order"."address") <= 300 and char_length("sale_order"."notes") <= 500

sale_order_amounts_check.name: sale_order_amounts_check
sale_order_amounts_check.value: "sale_order"."delivery_cents" between 0 and "sale_order"."delivery_list_cents" and "sale_order"."subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "sale_order"."discount_cents" >= 0 and "sale_order"."gift_cents" >= 0 and "sale_order"."total_cents" = "sale_order"."subtotal_cents" + "sale_order"."delivery_cents" - "sale_order"."return_credit_cents" and "sale_order"."margin_used_cents" between 0 and "sale_order"."margin_cents"

sale_order_exchange_check.name: sale_order_exchange_check
sale_order_exchange_check.value: "sale_order"."return_credit_cents" >= 0 and ("sale_order"."exchange_of_id" is not null or "sale_order"."return_credit_cents" = 0) and ("sale_order"."exchange_of_id" is null or "sale_order"."exchange_of_id" <> "sale_order"."id")

sale_order_cancel_check.name: sale_order_cancel_check
sale_order_cancel_check.value: ("sale_order"."state" = 'anulado') = ("sale_order"."cancel_reason" is not null) and ("sale_order"."cancel_reason" is null or char_length(btrim("sale_order"."cancel_reason")) between 3 and 300)

sale_order_tracking_check.name: sale_order_tracking_check
sale_order_tracking_check.value: "sale_order"."tracking" is null or char_length("sale_order"."tracking") between 1 and 80

sale_order_slot_check.name: sale_order_slot_check
sale_order_slot_check.value: ("sale_order"."slot_start" is null) = ("sale_order"."slot_end" is null) and ("sale_order"."slot_start" is null or ("sale_order"."slot_start" >= 0 and "sale_order"."slot_start" < "sale_order"."slot_end" and "sale_order"."slot_end" <= 1440))

sale_order_agency_check.name: sale_order_agency_check
sale_order_agency_check.value: "sale_order"."agency" is null or char_length(btrim("sale_order"."agency")) between 1 and 60

sale_order_line_price_check.name: sale_order_line_price_check
sale_order_line_price_check.value: "sale_order_line"."floor_unit_cents" <= "sale_order_line"."auto_unit_cents" and "sale_order_line"."auto_unit_cents" <= "sale_order_line"."list_unit_cents" and (case when "sale_order_line"."gift" then "sale_order_line"."unit_cents" = 0 else "sale_order_line"."unit_cents" between "sale_order_line"."floor_unit_cents" and "sale_order_line"."auto_unit_cents" end)

stock_movement_sign_check.name: stock_movement_sign_check
stock_movement_sign_check.value: case "stock_movement"."kind" when 'entrada' then "stock_movement"."quantity" > 0 when 'anulacion' then "stock_movement"."quantity" > 0 when 'devolucion' then "stock_movement"."quantity" > 0 when 'venta' then "stock_movement"."quantity" < 0 else "stock_movement"."quantity" <> 0 end

stock_movement_reason_check.name: stock_movement_reason_check
stock_movement_reason_check.value: ("stock_movement"."kind" not in ('ajuste','devolucion') or char_length(btrim(coalesce("stock_movement"."reason", ''))) >= 3) and ("stock_movement"."reason" is null or char_length("stock_movement"."reason") <= 300)

stock_movement_reference_check.name: stock_movement_reference_check
stock_movement_reference_check.value: ("stock_movement"."kind" in ('venta','anulacion','devolucion')) = ("stock_movement"."reference" is not null) and ("stock_movement"."reference" is null or char_length("stock_movement"."reference") between 1 and 80)

store_public_name_check.name: store_public_name_check
store_public_name_check.value: "store"."public_name" is null or char_length(btrim("store"."public_name")) between 1 and 80

store_agent_texts_check.name: store_agent_texts_check
store_agent_texts_check.value: ("store_agent"."display_name" is null or char_length(btrim("store_agent"."display_name")) between 1 and 60) and char_length("store_agent"."knowledge") <= 2000

store_delivery_method_price_check.name: store_delivery_method_price_check
store_delivery_method_price_check.value: ("store_delivery_method"."cost" = 'fijo') = ("store_delivery_method"."price_cents" is not null) and ("store_delivery_method"."price_cents" is null or "store_delivery_method"."price_cents" >= 0)

store_delivery_method_deal_check.name: store_delivery_method_deal_check
store_delivery_method_deal_check.value: ("store_delivery_method"."max_discount_cents" is null and "store_delivery_method"."free_from_cents" is null) or "store_delivery_method"."cost" in ('fijo','por_zona')

store_delivery_method_deal_amounts_check.name: store_delivery_method_deal_amounts_check
store_delivery_method_deal_amounts_check.value: ("store_delivery_method"."max_discount_cents" is null or "store_delivery_method"."max_discount_cents" > 0) and ("store_delivery_method"."free_from_cents" is null or "store_delivery_method"."free_from_cents" > 0)

store_invitation_pending_idx.name: store_invitation_pending_idx
store_invitation_pending_idx.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

store_invitation_closed_check.name: store_invitation_closed_check
store_invitation_closed_check.value: ("store_invitation"."accepted_at" is null or "store_invitation"."accepted_by" is not null) and ("store_invitation"."revoked_at" is null or "store_invitation"."revoked_by" is not null) and ("store_invitation"."accepted_at" is null or "store_invitation"."revoked_at" is null)

store_payment_method_kind_type_check.name: store_payment_method_kind_type_check
store_payment_method_kind_type_check.value:
case "store_payment_method"."kind"
        when 'yape' then "store_payment_method"."type_code" = '68' and "store_payment_method"."collection" = 'comprobante'
        when 'plin' then "store_payment_method"."type_code" = '68' and "store_payment_method"."collection" = 'comprobante'
        when 'transferencia' then "store_payment_method"."type_code" = '30' and "store_payment_method"."collection" = 'comprobante'
        when 'efectivo' then "store_payment_method"."type_code" = '10' and "store_payment_method"."collection" = 'al_recibir'
        when 'pos' then "store_payment_method"."type_code" = '48' and "store_payment_method"."collection" = 'al_recibir'
        when 'link' then "store_payment_method"."collection" = 'link'
        else "store_payment_method"."collection" <> 'link' end

store_payment_method_kind_data_check.name: store_payment_method_kind_data_check
store_payment_method_kind_data_check.value:
("store_payment_method"."kind" not in ('yape', 'plin') or ("store_payment_method"."phone" is not null and "store_payment_method"."holder" is not null))
        and ("store_payment_method"."kind" <> 'transferencia' or ("store_payment_method"."bank_code" is not null and "store_payment_method"."account_number" is not null and "store_payment_method"."holder" is not null))

store_support_access_answer_check.name: store_support_access_answer_check
store_support_access_answer_check.value: ("store_support_access"."state" = 'pedido') = ("store_support_access"."answered_at" is null) and ("store_support_access"."answered_at" is null) = ("store_support_access"."answered_by" is null) and ("store_support_access"."expires_at" is not null) = ("store_support_access"."state" in ('aceptado','quitado') and "store_support_access"."answered_at" is not null) and ("store_support_access"."state" = 'quitado') = ("store_support_access"."ended_at" is not null)

store_template_field_own_check.name: store_template_field_own_check
store_template_field_own_check.value: ("store_template_field"."label" is null) = ("store_template_field"."type" is null) and ("store_template_field"."type" is null or type IN ('opcion','numero','texto','por_talla','tabla','fecha')) and ("store_template_field"."label" is null or char_length(btrim("store_template_field"."label")) between 1 and 60) and ("store_template_field"."label" is not null or ("store_template_field"."options" is null and "store_template_field"."columns" is null and "store_template_field"."unit" is null))

store_template_field_values_check.name: store_template_field_values_check
store_template_field_values_check.value: ("store_template_field"."options" is null or cardinality("store_template_field"."options") between 1 and 20) and ("store_template_field"."columns" is null or cardinality("store_template_field"."columns") between 1 and 6) and ("store_template_field"."unit" is null or char_length(btrim("store_template_field"."unit")) between 1 and 12)

customer_fact_value_check.name: customer_fact_value_check
customer_fact_value_check.value: char_length(btrim("customer_fact"."value")) between 1 and 120 and ("customer_fact"."quote" is null or char_length("customer_fact"."quote") between 1 and 300) and cardinality("customer_fact"."alternatives") <= 4

customer_fact_origin_check.name: customer_fact_origin_check
customer_fact_origin_check.value: ("customer_fact"."source" <> 'chat' or ("customer_fact"."message_id" is not null and "customer_fact"."quote" is not null)) and ("customer_fact"."source" <> 'pedido' or "customer_fact"."order_id" is not null)
